nba.rules: Kalshi resolves on the game's winner; the DraftKings moneyline includes overtime. No ties.

nhl.rules: Kalshi resolves on the game's winner; the DraftKings moneyline includes overtime and the shootout. No ties.

mlb.rules: Kalshi resolves on the game's winner; the DraftKings moneyline is action (no listed-pitcher condition) and includes extra innings. Suspended or postponed games can resolve differently on each venue.

nfl.rules: Disabled: a tie pushes the DraftKings two-way moneyline (stake returned) while each Kalshi team market resolves No, so the basket can lose. Enable only after reading both venues' current tie rules.
